verdict.rationale: Fedora ships GNOME Software as a built-in app store, and Fedora's own docs claim one-click installs from Fedora repos, Flathub, or elsewhere (fedora-docs-8). However, a hands-on community report directly contradicts this ease-of-use claim, describing needing to run a page of terminal commands to install popular apps like Discord/Spotify, apps not running correctly, and installed GUI apps failing to appear in the app menu (fedora-comm-15). Missing for 10: independent corroboration that one-click installs consistently work smoothly across popular apps, and no rebuttal/fix evidence for the failure case cited.
